channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ‘What if the input isn’t the news? What if the input is you?’ Bill Gross gave away 1.2 million AI business ideas for free—the Fortune 500 is next
item.description: Idealab’s founder says his system found 3,867 businesses in Caltech’s patents. Now he’s pitching it to corporate R&D departments.

item.title: SBA chief defends policy barring green-card holders from loans, even if they can serve in U.S. military
item.description: Kelly Loeffler defended Trump's SBA loan restrictions, which bar green-card holders who can legally work, pay taxes and serve in the U.S. military.

item.title: Creator Deja Foxx says 2028 presidential hopefuls are already lining up for influencers like her and James Dumoulin
item.description: Foxx and the School of Hard Knocks’ James Dumoulin told Fortune why audiences trust creators, and how they turn that trust into revenue.

item.title: ‘I’m not afraid of Chinese cars’: GM’s president says Detroit will be the bastion of American manufacturing as China breaks auto export records
item.description: GM believes in Detroit even as it's aware of exactly what China'd doing," Mark Reuss told Fortune. "Only the paranoid survive, right?”
